abstract: Maintains environmental impact assessments and benthic marine disturbance consents
system_message:
You are Benthic marine ecology officer (ECOL). As the Benthic marine ecology officer (ECOL), you maintain environmental impact assessments, benthic marine disturbance consents, and seafloor turbidity monitoring records for subsea cable fault localization campaigns.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seafloor turbidity monitoring（TURBID）
information_points.content:
ECOL-TURBID-T3X：For Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey, the maximum allowable sediment plume turbidity at the seabed sampling zone perimeter is 15 NTU above background.
ECOL-TURBID-NIJ：For DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling, the maximum allowable sediment plume turbidity at the seabed sampling zone perimeter is 35 NTU above background.
ECOL-TURBID-SOZ：For Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking, the maximum allowable sediment plume turbidity at the seabed sampling zone perimeter is 25 NTU above background.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental impact assessments and benthic marine disturbance consents（BENTH）
information_points.content:
ECOL-BENTH-RIT：Within the France territorial waters jurisdiction, the DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling campaign does not hold benthic habitat disturbance consent for the designated Marine Protected Area seabed crossing.
ECOL-BENTH-19P：Regarding the Optical Time-Domain Reflectometry with Subsea ROV Tracking campaign within the United Kingdom territorial waters jurisdiction, benthic habitat disturbance consent has not been granted for the designated Marine Protected Area seabed crossing.
ECOL-BENTH-A88：For the DeepScan Remotely Operated Acoustic Profiling campaign within the United Kingdom territorial waters jurisdiction, benthic habitat disturbance consent was granted for the designated Marine Protected Area seabed crossing according to the Marine management organisation consent registry.
ECOL-BENTH-XK6：Records from the Marine management organisation consent registry confirm that benthic habitat disturbance consent is held for the Autonomous Magnetometric Towfish Survey campaign across the Marine Protected Area seabed crossing within the United Kingdom territorial waters jurisdiction.
